canonical_split_plan.prompts: derived at runtime; prompt files are never source of truth

invariants: Machine-owned metadata MUST NOT be generated by an LLM: run/response IDs, canonical object IDs, versions, hashes, counts, schema/contract identity and transport-completion flags are assigned or computed by the orchestrator.
LLM output is semantic only. It may propose typed operations, routes and stage-scoped dispositions; the orchestrator wraps that payload in a trusted ResponseEnvelope before validation/commit.

One canonical mechanism per concern: ObjectRef for identity, provenance for lineage, mutations for change, dispositions only for true set transformations, hashes for integrity, runtime completion flags for truncation/transport integrity.
Visual BEGIN/END, item counters, diff summaries and similar markers are UI projections only; they MUST NOT become parallel sources of truth.
Canonical object IDs are allocated by the orchestrator and never reused. Models use response-local temp_id values only for objects created in the same semantic response.
A model response can never be committed unless transport_complete, parse_complete, semantic_schema_valid, policy_valid and integrity_valid are all true.
30 architecture-process stages are preserved as the canonical content model.
Human input: one free-form IDEA, then selection-only questionnaire before G1; after G1 normal path is automatic except execution of HUMAN_TEST.
A model never expands its own authority and never impersonates Owner or Human Tester.
All mutable domain state is versioned in RegistryEntry; hard delete is forbidden.
Graph describes data dependency/provenance; controlFlow describes execution order, loops and waits.
Gates and Definition-of-Done are computed predicates, never manual checkboxes.
Model output is a mutation proposal; only validated atomic commit changes project state.
Consensus of models is not evidence.
Prompts are compiled at runtime from manifest contracts and are not an independent source of truth.
Every model call receives a frozen input_snapshot_id plus input_snapshot_hash.
Every model response uses AL-STRUCT-1 and contains no prose outside its single JSON object.
Existing canonical objects are referenced by ObjectRef first; model must not invent canonical IDs or versions.
Prompt assembly order is deterministic: RULES -> STATE -> ACTIVE -> DELTA -> TASK.
RAW, CANONICAL and CONTEXT representations are separate; CONTEXT compaction never mutates RAW/CANONICAL.
Required context is never silently evicted; unresolved context overflow fails closed.
Accepted provider messages are idempotent by transport-owned source_message_id.
CONSUMED means input processed only; it never implies domain closure, verification, or gate passage.
Roles constrain expected output/permissions but do not grant arbitration authority over sibling models.
Each model call persists a reproducible context-assembly audit recipe.
